name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a reusable Codex workflow with one permanent coordination-only project hub and up to five user-visible execution tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and rotate a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts the bootstrap task as a coordination-only permanent project hub, safely upgrades installed workflow files, and coordinates up to five user-visible execution tasks with fail-closed task management.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow to safely plan or apply an upgrade without overwriting project-owned state.
